source_state: uncommitted shared text-step permits and cumulative retained-token sampling quotes
behavior: Core acquires a move-only backend step permit after exact session admission and before controller decisions or native input creation. Ordinary output remains asynchronous; controlled output holds the permit through token observation, exact completion and controller commitment.

Core-issued run, policy and attempt evidence survives restoration; local issuance consumes an ordinal before peer agreement. Forked machines get distinct identities while preparation clones only retain their charge.

Prediction, Decision and controlled Commitment use the existing bounded rank coordinator. Local admission and callback errors still agree failure and preserve their original typed cause. Successful peers stop before subsequent work.
Controller/sampler mutation, host-state installation and fallible instrumentation hooks replace policy identity before mutation. A nonmutating phase rejection leaves identity unchanged.

The current native permit validates session, model/context domains, parameter epoch, prediction phase and canonical preparation bindings, then acquires unquoted authority. A retained reservation is never an alternative allocation permit.

Sampling inspection retains every emitted token backing across the output allowance, deduplicates genuine aliases, preserves unknown capacities and rejects arithmetic overflow. Native tests retain four real greedy/stochastic tokens while their logits and displaced RNG parents retire.

Native continuation tests reject stale sampler epochs, equal-geometry replacement prompts, substituted sampler reservations and reserved model/context pools before callbacks, input construction or model-state changes.
limits: Public strict native memory admission still returns UnknownBound; this increment does not issue a complete quoted run grant.

Canonical initial run/policy binding must happen before mutable exposure. The existing runtime TextPreparationAuthority still needs monotone run claims and exact predecessor-token receipts; historical request retention is insufficient.
Complete preparation/instrumentation quotes, mutable-control repricing, nonempty-state identity handoff, quoted independent copies and complete media/paging/distributed admission remain unfinished.

Token retention after serial completion does not price separately retained completion objects, raw logits, observers or arbitrary callback allocations. These require their own complete lifetime contracts.

Four positive public strict-budget tests remain ignored; the portable LFM tokenizer fixture also requires its external checkpoint. No additional peak, released-checkpoint or native distributed measurements were made.
corrected_validation_findings: A preliminary core fixture changed capabilities before startup, causing existing startup rejection; it now changes them after startup to exercise step admission.

Portable completion-retention probing now records actual one-time lease resolution through either polling or waiting. Peer prediction/decision rejection permits only the expected failed-delivery cleanup vote.
Native epoch binding uses the existing validate_parameter_epoch method instead of accessing its private field. The native rejection fixture matches the exact transparent error wrapper.

The preliminary RNG assertion incorrectly required the entire split parent as a lower bound. Greedy has no RNG; stochastic U32[2] key backing can be smaller than the split parent. Final tests record actual capacity and compare it with a conservative allocator bound.
The Metal fixture uses a dedicated CPU residency source stream while preserving Metal execution.
